title: Playlist and Semester
author: Sable Eriksen
blurb: Quentin Coldharbour, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
